tagline: From the Erie Canal north to the lakes around Piseco.
intro: From Herkimer and Little Falls on the Erie Canal the trail heads north by Newport into the southern Adirondacks, through Nobleboro and Hoffmeister, then loops around Piseco Lake, named by an early surveyor for a man called Pezeeko who lived on its shore, and carries on to Speculator.

Along the way the byway sends families digging at the Herkimer Diamond Mine. Herkimer diamonds are not diamonds at all but quartz crystals, grown slowly in cavities of the dolomite and named for their clarity and their neat faces.

moments.title: Little Falls
moments.text: The Mohawk falls 45 feet in less than a mile through a rocky defile here, and the Palatine settlers who came about 1723 were the westernmost Europeans in the colony.

moments.title: Nobleboro
moments.text: Where the South Branch runs into West Canada Creek, an overlook and kiosk mark the remains of a pulpwood boom and a rossing mill.

moments.title: Speculator
moments.text: The village was Newton's Corners until 1896, when it took the name of the 2,966-foot mountain seen across Lake Pleasant.
